abstract: We respond to concerns regarding reference-label-informed epoch selection in SpatialDG. We acknowledge this limitation and report a matched DLPFC reevaluation of SpatialDG and Spatial-MGCN under the same reference-label-independent checkpoint-selection rule, in which SpatialDG achieved the higher three-seed mean ARI on all 12 slices.
